changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table project_phase ( id uuid not null, project_id uuid not null, title varchar(255) not null, description text, status varchar(20) not null check (status in ('CREATED','ACTIVE','TERMINATED')), weight numeric(5,2) not null default 0, completion numeric(5,2) not null default 0, start_date date, end_date date, first_start_date date, first_end_date date, created_by varchar(255), created_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null, primary key (id) );
alter table project_phase add constraint fk_phase_project foreign key (project_id) references project (id) on delete cascade;

rollback.sql: drop table if exists project_phase cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table project_phase_audit ( id uuid not null, rev integer not null, revtype smallint, project_id uuid, title varchar(255), description text, status varchar(20), weight numeric(5,2), completion numeric(5,2), start_date date, end_date date, first_start_date date, first_end_date date, created_by varchar(255), created_at timestamp(6) with time zone, primary key (rev, id) );
alter table project_phase_audit add constraint fk_phase_audit_revinfo foreign key (rev) references revinfo (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists project_phase_audit cascade;
